summary: Oak Woods Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval to extend its business combination deadline from March 28, 2026 to March 28, 2027. The Extraordinary General Meeting on July 8, 2026 voted on the Charter Amendment and Adjournment Proposals. No price, stake, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The extension provides additional time to complete a de-SPAC transaction. Watch for future announcements of a target business combination or further extensions; risk-arb focuses on trust value and redemption trends.
